notes.title: Mini S'mores Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello chefs![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/397f6f0d797b3cf7127b35145094f3f0dc6d848b.png"][/img][/p][p]We weren't planning on doing an update until the end of September, but we had these marshmallows laying around and we're honestly a bit addicted to all your kind words whenever we drop new content so here's the [b]Mini S'mores Update[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]This is a tiny update featuring [b]2 new ingredients[/b], and [b]2 new helpers[/b] including a [b]new Mythic [/b]for [b]Scoochie Special[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/d917e8509aebdba57a6b5a5181155fc5286eb695.png"][/img][/p][p]What I'm most excited about is a feature we fast-tracked from our upcoming Major Update: [b]Weekly Runs[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][b]Every Tuesday[/b], there will be a [b]brand-new starter pantry[/b]! This starter pantry will come with a predetermined Mode and Apron, so everyone will be competing on the same leaderboard.[/p][p][/p][p]These Weekly Runs will provide a more focused leaderboard experience for you chefs out there with a competitive spirit. Since these are time-limited, we won't worry so much about balance and just make fun combos and/or unique challenges.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/c91ae2e689e8c2f754c7df7a178e14b0ba976836.png"][/img][/p][p]To showcase the new content, our inaugural Weekly starter pantry will of course be S'mores themed! Check back on September 23rd and [b]every Tuesday[/b] for [b]new Weekly Runs[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Lastly, we want to show you the new post-run summary screen. There's now stats highlighting your best ingredients, the time elapsed, money earned, your personal best score, and your leaderboard rank.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/6bc8598901ff8e2b77a21620238aaa34f2e07d63.png"][/img][/p][p]We also added a button to save a screenshot of your summary screen to Steam! We hope this feature lets you more easily share some of your favorite runs. We'd love to see some of your favorites [url="https://discord.gg/pG9jkK3BTZ"]on Discord[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]Speaking of Discord, we'll be running a poll to determine the theme of the next Weekly Starter Pantry. Join now to decide what we're cooking next week!

 [url="https://discord.gg/pG9jkK3BTZ" style="button"]Vote Now![/url][/p][p][/p][p]We've also added some pretty neat quality of life improvements to help you understand all these wacky new tags more easily. See the patch notes for details.[/p][p][/p][p]We're hard at work on the 2nd Major Update, coming at the very end of September! See you then, chefs![/p][p][/p][p]-Chef Schu
[/p][h2]v0.8.31 Patch Notes[/h2][h3]Content[/h3][list][*][p]2 new ingredients (Marshmallow and Graham Cracker)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New WEEKLY starter pantry[/b][/p][list][*][p]Starting with a S'mores Pantry to showcase our newest ingredients[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Scoochie Special Mythic Helper[/p][list][*][p]Same as Infinite Mystery Box, but also gives you extra ingredients to choose from while trashing so you have more control over your pantry[/p][/*][*][p]Infinite Mystery Box rarity changed to Uncommon[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Quality of Life[/h3][list][*][p]Post-Match Summary Screen Rework[/p][list][*][p]Added stats for most used/highest scoring ingredients, time, $ earned, personal best and rank[/p][/*][*][p]Added screenshot button that saves summary screen to your Steam Library[/p][list][*][p]We'd love to see your favorite builds! Come share them [url="https://discord.gg/pG9jkK3BTZ"]on Discord[/url]![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Confetti particles don't overlap UI[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Tweaked how ingredients are dispensed[/p][list][*][p]In turn-based mode, the conveyor stops once all ingredients are centered[/p][list][*][p]This is how it worked for both modes before[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]In real-time mode, the conveyor slows down as soon as they're all visible[/p][list][*][p]This is new and will give you slightly more time to decide in real-time mode[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Increased width that ingredients spawn on trash belt (so they're not so crammed together)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Reworked tooltip descriptions for tags so you know where points come from. Some examples:[/p][list][*][p]"-1x to self (Wrapped)"[/p][list][*][p]this ingredient is Wrapped and usually won't score on its own[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]"+5 pts (On Fire +3)"[/p][list][*][p]this ingredient scores 2 on its own (like Bacon), and 3 from fire[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]-3 pts (Moldy)[/p][list][*][p]Previously Lobster Mushroom just said -3 pts. Now it's clear it comes from the Mold[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added mid-game tutorials for Moldy, On Fire, and Wrapped[/p][/*][*][p]No customer requests on last round (since money doesn't matter)[/p][/*][/list][h3]Balance[/h3][list][*][p]Sous Chef Sharon (+1 dispensed ingredient) costs 4 instead of 5[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed bug where Atomically Condensed Milk (double mult for dairy) didn't work[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked Finisher helper[/p][list][*][p]Fixed bug where it wouldn't apply if you have more dispenses than ingredients[/p][/*][*][p]Now if you ignore dispensed ingredients, it'll still apply to the last chosen ingredient[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Particles are scaled properly on saved omelets displayed in post-match[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Spicy Hot Fire Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello chefs![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/983fac78ddafa4011b844c4e9b3bde87941bf13c.png"][/img][/p][p]2 weeks ago you voted [url="https://discord.gg/pG9jkK3BTZ"]on our Discord[/url] for the Spicy Hot Fire Update, and here it is! We've finally given some meaning to the Spicy tag and added [b]5 more Spicy ingredients[/b] to the catalogue (plus [b]3 non-Spicy ones[/b]). So what does Spicy do now?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/16b7c6abc7b40902f35ec7928b0bde5345df8fb7.png"][/img][/p][p]Spicy ingredients start 🔥[b]On Fire[/b]🔥, which means they'll score an extra [b]3 points[/b] at the end of the round. After some time, On Fire ingredients will start burning which spreads the fire to touching ingredients and eventually leads to them becoming Burnt, scoring a massive [b]-10 points instead[/b]. But don't worry, you can give them a little [b]shake to extinguish them[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/308501c70808870cb4a9130ef1338bb5f3bf9a12.gif"][/img][/p][p]We've also added [b]3 new Pyromaniac Customers[/b] who want to see a bit of chaos and will occasionally throw [b]lit matches[/b] onto your omelets.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/d8dae636e27c80a09c794e4e7cdf06ebcc559b90.gif"][/img][/p][p]All of this can be experienced in a brand [b]new Spicy starter pantry[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]We've also made some quality of life adjustments you can check out in the patch notes. If you have ideas for more let us know![/p][p][/p][p]Our next update will be the highly requested [b]Endless Update[/b], coming at the very end of September. We've got a long list of features we want to add to make the game even more replayable. As a reminder, here's our current roadmap. Your feedback and requests will help us fill it out in the coming months![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/74796ea3c61931f0f0b95a69fe78b14f858a3b3b.png"][/img][/p][p]We're also running our first of many free game giveaways and some polls to figure out what content you've enjoyed most so far over on [url="https://discord.gg/pG9jkK3BTZ"]our Discord[/url]![/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FpG9jkK3BTZ" style="button"]Enter the Giveaway![/url][/p][p][/p][p]We of course also need to acknowledge that thanks to you we've crossed 400 reviews and somehow still 100% positive! That's insane and we truly appreciate you chefs for helping us achieve that milestone. We'll be doing something big once we hit 500![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/e40eca3e6e996c6197b6317eeb6973aa7cb77baa.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks for cooking with us chefs,[/p][p]-Chef Schu[/p][p][/p][h2]v0.8.30 Patch Notes[/h2][h3]Content[/h3][list][*][p]8 new ingredients[/p][/*][*][p]new Spicy starter pantry[/p][/*][*][p]new Mythic helper[/p][/*][*][p]new Pyromaniac customer trait[/p][/*][*][p]3 new Pyromaniac customers[/p][/*][*][p]Added On Fire and Burnt tags[/p][list][*][p]On Fire gives +3 pts[/p][/*][*][p]Burnt gives -10 pts[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]new Spicy crate available in shop[/p][/*][*][p][i]a secret new interaction?[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3]Quality of Life[/h3][list][*][p]Ingredient rotation is no longer dependent on framerate[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial popups appear the first time you have a Spicy, Underlapper, or Garnish ingredient[/p][list][*][p]We plan to add more of these and eventually other ways to help chefs remember what unexplained mechanics do without being overwhelming or repetitive[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Mold, Gold, On Fire, and Burnt tooltips explain in parentheses when points come from that tag[/p][/*][*][p]Added slight delay to "Continue" button in shop so you don't click it before seeing the options[/p][/*][/list][h3]Balance[/h3][list][*][p]Forks and Matchsticks can't spawn during the last chance timer[/p][/*][*][p]Banana[/p][list][*][p]"+1 pt per 2 ingredients in discard" changed to "+0.1x per ingredient in discard"[/p][/*][*][p]Added Wrapped tag[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Chili [/p][list][*][p]"+1 pt per ingredient on omelet" changed to "+2 pts to each ingredient touching"[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced rarity to Rare[/p][/*][*][p]We wanted to give Spicy a clear identity of buffing ingredients they touch[/p][/*][*][p]Chili was picked 74% of the time, a whopping 10% more than the 2nd highest ingredient (Lime). We tend to avoid nerfing things just for being good but considering the other points and the fact this ingredient was so far ahead of others (the average being around 32% pick rate), it was an easy decision to rework it[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Jalapeno[/p][list][*][p]"+1x to touching ingredients, -5 per touching ingredient" changed to "+4 pts to touching ingredients, -2pts per touching ingredient"[/p][/*][*][p]Jalapeno's old ability has been given to the new Spicy pepper that Jalapeno unlocks because we feel it's more befitting of a Legendary ingredient[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Category Collector (Helper)[/p][list][*][p]"$0.25 per distinct tag on omelet" to "$0.25 per 2 distinct tags on omelet"[/p][/*][*][p]Using just 2-3 ingredients chefs were already getting $2+ every round, which felt far too strong for the amount of skill/thought needed. This should still be quite strong for chefs using diverse pantries[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Corn Dog[/p][list][*][p]Reduced rarity to Rare (it's a weird ingredient but not good enough to be Legendary)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Art[/h3][list][*][p]New Baked icon (On Fire uses the old one)[/p][/*][*][p]New Fruit Crate visual[/p][/*][*][p]Root Crate renamed to Root Sack[/p][/*][*][p][i]Note: Our artist, Hjalte, was a lil extra busy so our programmer, Schu, did a few assets for this update. Hjalte has been gradually replacing the original assets that no longer meet our quality bar. So basically if you see any assets that look kinda mid that's my bad and Hjalte will fix it eventually :)[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed bug where sometimes Helpers didn't earn money when they should[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where tooltips could be slightly offscreen for ingredients in bottom row of pantry[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tutorial that said "Sir Peck-a-Lot" instead of "Sir Pecks-a-Lot". Put some respect on his name[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 2 instances where UI said "Relic" instead of "Helper"[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Cheesy Update
notes.notes: [p]Welcome, chefs![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/bf1a6ac648fe3b005c5a55b5e3a64666a00deddd.png"][/img][/p][p]Cheese - the glue that holds together every great omelet. We've rebalanced existing cheeses and added [b]6 new ones[/b] to help ensure every omelet can be enhanced to its fullest extent. Maybe you'll create something extra cheesy?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/5f28b5407cfc7d84822a9d80617014e887cf9715.png"][/img][/p][p]Huh, someone left a couple uncommon veggies laying around. You might as well take them too, chef.[/p][p][/p][p]As for the helpers, there are [b]7 new ones[/b]! Many of these helpers will help enhance these new cheeses. One of them even unlocks the true potential of Moldy ingredients. Perhaps you'll try it with the new Blue Cheese?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/0aa9201c764ecc704e5ffa9556322042963e41dd.png"][/img][/p][p]I'll allow you to discover what they all do yourself, chef! That's all for this update, but the next update will be decided by [u][b]YOU![/b][/u] Head over to [url="https://discord.gg/pG9jkK3BTZ"]our Discord[/url] where you can participate in a poll that will determine what our next update will include. This next one will probably take around 2 weeks this time, and afterwards we'll begin working on our 2nd Major Update: Endless Mode which will arrive in late September.[/p][p][/p][p]So what do you want to see, chef? More Seafood? Tiny, undetectable legumes? Sticky Ingredients? A new radius mechanic? Or maybe some Hot Spicy Fire?[/p][p] [url="https://discord.gg/pG9jkK3BTZ" style="button"]Vote Now![/url][/p][p][/p][p]See you in a couple weeks, chefs![/p][p]-Chef Schu[/p][p][/p][h2]v0.8.28 Patch Notes[/h2][h3]Content[/h3][list][*][p][b]8[/b] new ingredients[/p][list][*][p][b]6[/b] new cheeses[/p][/*][*][p][b]2[/b] new uncommon veggies[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]7[/b] new helpers[/p][/*][*][p]Cheese Rebalanced[/p][list][*][p]There's now a cheese for each Texture and Preparation tag, as well as some cheeses that enable Dairy-focused builds and more well rounded cheeses. Our goal with this update was to make it so chefs want to use a cheese or 2 in their builds, just like any omelet is better with cheese.[/p][/*][*][p]American Cheese buffs [strike]everything[/strike] [b]Processed[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Cheddar [strike]buffs Soft[/strike] gives points to touching Dairy ingredients[/p][/*][*][p]Havarti removed[/p][/*][*][p]Tags and rarities adjusted[/p][/*][*][p]Common cheeses now unlock more advanced cheeses[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Art[/h3][list][*][p]Swiss cheese uses Havarti graphic[/p][/*][*][p]New Goat Cheese graphic[/p][/*][*][p]New Brie graphic[/p][/*][/list][h3]Balance[/h3][list][*][p]Fired Helpers trigger themself first before being destroyed[/p][list][*][p][i]Exotic Supplier[/i] now grants a legendary ingredient when fired[/p][/*][*][p][i]Severance Package[/i] can no longer be fired[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Moldy Customers have [strike]50%[/strike] [b]40%[/b] chance of applying Moldy to ingredients[/p][/*][*][p]Moldy can't appear in first 2 rounds[/p][list][*][p]We like that Moldy is a difficult trait and one that may require some planning to counter. Now you'll always have at least 2 rounds to prepare your pantry for Moldy and should have more dispenses that aren't full mold. We'll continue to monitor the difficulty.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Cucumber now unlocks Pickle, Goat Cheese unlocks Brie[/p][list][*][p]You'll need to unlock both of these to play Scoochie Special again[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Reworked colliders again to improve framerate (DJs should be better)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Grower/Shrinker customer traits (again)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where ingredients wouldn't pulse transparently when off omelet[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where all outlines would highlight when hovering helpers from crate[/p][/*][*][p]Probably fixed bug where game could soft lock during scoring if ingredient was taken by conveyor belt at the start of scoring[/p][list][*][p]If this happens to you, please send your \[USER]/AppData/LocalLow/SchuBoxGames/OmeletYouCook/Player.log to [url="https://SchuBoxStudio@gmail.com"]SchuBoxStudio@gmail.com[/url], or in [url="https://discord.gg/pG9jkK3BTZ"]our Discord[/url]. Thank you![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: The Moldy Mushroom Update
notes.notes:
[p]Welcome to the Moldy Mushroom Update, chefs![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/db22409131795321accffcdccd61ecb9fd181a0a.png"][/img][/p][p]Any great school cafeteria comes with a small chance of ingesting mold, so Principal Clucker has decided to unleash it upon Middlesville Cafeteria. Not only will [b]Mold[/b] [b]take away 3pts[/b] from infected ingredients, there's a[b] 50/50 chance it'll spread[/b] whenever it touches an untarnished ingredient! Be careful, [b]Mold[/b] can be found from many sources: customers, ingredients, and even some helpers![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/d6273edcacc82e93e0742ad96252ad2abc3a6468.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]To counteract this problem we've introduced [b]6[/b] new mushrooms who tend to prefer keeping their distance.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/3f6f1ad0cc209368652c8975209a65397fcd9bcf.png"][/img][/p][p]Principal Clucker has recruited [b]4[/b] new customers, all of which have a chance of turning ingredients moldy![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/228f8116906c17f6985347bb53d33afd7c16f31d.png"][/img][/p][p]Lastly, there's a [b]brand new Moldy Mushroom starter pantry[/b] alongside [b]3[/b] relevant new helpers!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/02a9dd7a6022df153e0abd397616101892dffb9e.png"][/img][/p][p]Aside from content, I want to highlight a few big quality of life changes:[/p][list][*][p](Settings) Target Framerate (so your computer doesn't try too hard)[/p][/*][*][p](Settings) Ingredient Input Method ([b]drag-drop[/b] vs [b]click-drop[/b], see details in patch notes)[/p][/*][*][p]New physics colliders[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tooltips (they don't go offscreen)[/p][/*][/list][p]As always there's a bunch of bug fixes and what not detailed in the patch notes. We're excited for y'all to check out all this [b]Mold[/b] and let us know what you think![/p][p][/p][p]Keep cooking on,[/p][p]Chef Schu[/p][p][/p][h2]v0.8.26 Patch Notes[/h2][h3]Content[/h3][list][*][p]Added [b]MOLD[/b] mechanic[/p][list][*][p]-3 pts to ingredient, can spread to other ingredients on touch[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]6[/b] new Fungi ingredients[/p][/*][*][p][b]4[/b] new moldy customers[/p][/*][*][p][b]3[/b] new helpers[/p][/*][*][p]New moldy [b]starter pantry[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3]Quality of Life[/h3][list][*][p]Reworked Tooltips[/p][list][*][p]They can no longer be offscreen[/p][/*][*][p]When hovering ingredients/helpers in your pantry there is a static tooltip that won't cover other ingredients/helpers in your pantry so you can see all synergies[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added icons for Aprons/Modes to show which combinations you've completed (same as pantries)[/p][/*][*][p]Added target framerate to settings[/p][/*][*][p]Added "[b]Drag-Drop[/b]" vs "[b]Click-Drop[/b]" input method option in settings[/p][list][*][p][b]Drag-Drop [/b]is the original input method. [b]Click-Drop[/b] changes it so when you click the ingredient it sticks to your cursor until you click again to place it. This should be a huge accessibility improvement for users who find it difficult to constantly hold down a mouse and for laptop trackpad input.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Adjusted rotation sensitivity, made it framerate independent[/p][/*][*][p]Added one-way rotation with right click while dragging[/p][/*][*][p]Changed "Fire Helper" button colors to be more accessible[/p][/*][/list][h3]Balance[/h3][list][*][p][b]Reworked all physics colliders[/b][/p][list][*][p]This was done to specifically solve an issue where the inner curve of ingredients (eggplant, chili, banana) didn't always collide properly. As a result all colliders should be more accurate. This is a big change so if you notice anything working in a way you wouldn't expect, please let us know![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Basic Bundle is now called Mystery Box (since it can be literally anything, not just the basics)[/p][/*][*][p]Squid wiggles even when off the omelet[/p][/*][*][p]"Mushroom" renamed to "Baby Bella Mushroom", unlocks Portabello Mushroom instead of Pickle[/p][list][*][p]Pickle is currently unlocked from the start, but will be unlocked by something in the future[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Pineapple is Soft (had no texture previously)[/p][/*][/list][h3]Art[/h3][list][*][p]New art for crates: Mystery Box, Dairy Crate[/p][/*][*][p]New Dairy icon[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced Milk Jug with BBQ Sauce helper (+2 to Meats)[/p][/*][*][p]Renamed "Superstitious Supervisor" to "Lenny the Observant" (cuz he deserves a name)[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed bug where dollar/quarter indicators sometimes didn't appear when dragging ingredients[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where large ingredients sometimes weren't large (for real this time)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where adjustment timer could block input[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where rotating omelet could have ingredients snatched by conveyor belt[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where duplicated Hater Helpers didn't retain their value[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where pointing customers would point at [b]Principal Clucker[/b][/p][list][*][p][i][b]Principal Clucker[/b] is displeased and has placed Mrs Gee Gee on probation[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where gold ingredients wouldn't highlight in pantry when they should[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Big Boss Bertha's sprite[/p][/*][*][p]Fools Gold no longer triggers while trashing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where there could be duplicate crates in starter pantries with more common crates[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where "Take Random" tooltip said "ingredient" when taking a random helper[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where Round tooltip was positioned weirdly + round text overlaps less often[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The Pointy Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello chefs![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/cc3cfb5ba2744e52f6b7654a8d7e86376a158f78.png"][/img][/p][p]We're super excited to introduce a bunch of new content for you today. First off, we've introduced a new way to score points — with ingredients that point![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/eee76cc533d08d01be15d8506094e32cddff4127.png"][/img][/p][p]You'll find this new mechanic used across [b]5 pointy new ingredients[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/191f420a852b2843394dbf5eba6c6509d1bbaefe.png"][/img][/p][p]Plus [b]3 new customers[/b] who will point at part of the omelet that they'd prefer you leave empty!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/503256fc2be9cb5fd7ea596e374dd81d1f14fd59.png"][/img][/p][p]And now for my personal favorite part of the update: [b]6 new helpers[/b]! Most of these play with the [b]FIRING[/b] mechanic we introduced in the Artisan Update. I won't spoil too much but these are some of my favorite helpers we've added so far and I'm really excited to see what you chefs do with them![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/36ac53f9a1ac6e5d36a227db7b8a9da913422a31.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We've also [b]reworked the Scoochie Special starter pantry[/b] to include a fun [b]new Mythic helper[/b], buffed some underutilized helpers, and fixed a ton of the bugs you've been helping us find.[/p][p][/p][p]We're excited to see what y'all cook next![/p][p]-Chef Schu[/p][p][/p][h2]v0.8.24 Patch Notes[/h2][h3]Content[/h3][list][*][p]New mechanic: pointing at ingredients[/p][/*][*][p]New customer trait: Pointer (-0.5x mult to ingredients pointed at)[/p][/*][*][p]5 new ingredients[/p][/*][*][p]3 new customers[/p][/*][*][p]6 new helpers[/p][/*][/list][h3]Quality of Life[/h3][list][*][p]Ingredients that apply mult to self now say "-1x to self" instead of just "-1x"[/p][/*][*][p]Gold is displayed as a separate line-item on receipt[/p][/*][/list][h3]Balancing[/h3][list][*][p][b]Scoochie Special starter pantry[/b]: Replaced Sous Chef Sharon helper with a [b]new Mythic helper[/b][/p][list][*][p]Since nerfing Apple, this pantry became unfun and too rigid to play, especially since Sharon had anti-synergy with Apples. Now I think it'll be one of the most exciting pantries.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Steamed tag removed[/p][list][*][p]We did this to improve gameplay balance. There were only 4 Steamed ingredients, and the associated helpers were some of the least taken. Most are now Baked, which had the 2nd fewest ingredients amongst the "baking method" tags. It will be easier for us to properly balance across the 3 tags now.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Steampipe helper (+0.4x to Steamed ingredients)[/p][/*][*][p]Heated Historian now buffs Baked per Raw on omelet (instead of Steamed per Baked)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Root and Fruit Finesser: [strike]+2pts[/strike] [b]+4pts[/b] to each Root per 2 Fruit on omelet[/p][/*][*][p]Cheesy Meaty Meddler: +[strike]2pts[/strike] [b]+4pts[/b] to each Dairy per 2 Meat on omelet[/p][/*][*][p]Charcuterie Chef: [strike]+0.4x[/strike] [b]+0.2x[/b] to each Fruit per [strike]2[/strike] [b]1[/b] Dairy on omelet[/p][list][*][p]These 3 were some of the least picked helpers so we wanted to give them a minor buff. We'll monitor whether this makes them more viable or if they need additional tweaking[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Donut: [strike]-0.2x[/strike] [b]+0.2x[/b] per Sweet on omelet[/p][list][*][p]Idk why it was giving negative mult to Sweets. Did I do that on purpose? No idea. It should be more befitting of a Legendary ingredient now![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Adjusted how some ingredients are unlocked to fit with new ingredient unlocks[/p][/*][*][p]Spinach is Chewy (had no texture tag previously)[/p][/*][*][p]Watermelon is Sweet + Large, no longer Crunchy[/p][/*][*][p]Hot Dog and Banana are Large[/p][/*][/list][h3]Art[/h3][list][*][p]Upscaled desktop icon[/p][/*][*][p]Updated art for Processing Factory helper[/p][/*][*][p]Better graphic for Firing helpers[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed bug where sometimes Large ingredients randomly lost Large tag[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where Quick Restart could add a bunch of random ingredients to your pantry in round 1[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where player could skip before trashable ingredients were finished dispensing[/p][/*][*][p]Probably fixed bug where ingredients could get stuck above conveyor while restocking[/p][/*][*][p]Probably fixed bug where customer receipt didn't always fully print[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where locked crates could award more than 1 dispense[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where Travel Trash Dog could trash ingredients during trashing phase[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where Travel Trash Dog only trashed 1st ingredient in a round[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where you could quickly buy 2 helpers, taking you over the helper limit[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where trashable ingredients could be dragged after an ingredient was already trashed (they would remain on screen for the rest of eternity)[/p][/*][*][p]Discard resets properly at start of each round[/p][/*][*][p]Gold ingredients in catalogue now have Gold material[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The Artisan Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello chefs! We're happy to introduce the first major update for [b]Omelet You Cook[/b]!
[/p][p]I'll start by tempering expectations by saying that we couldn't get quite as much content in as we planned, but we'll be returning to pseudo-weekly content updates to keep the kitchen stocked throughout the summer! [i](we've been busy moving to a new city, [/i][url="https://hjaltetagmose.itch.io/lil-dude-racers"]game jamming[/url][i], and fixing the dozens of bugs you've helped us find)[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/efce1b53cabb011f1846eeeec117e24bcb47af16.png"][/img][/p][p]The big change in this update is a [b]reworked Apron system[/b] with full support for playing the game completely at your leisure with [b]no time pressure[/b]. This update is for all you artisans out there who want to take your time and create a true masterpiece.[/p][p][/p][p]This means in addition to your [b]Apron[/b] you'll select your [b]Hat[/b] to determine whether you play [b]turn-based[/b] or in [b]real-time[/b]. The [b]real-time mode is the intended experience[/b] but we know the time pressure really stresses out or makes the game inaccessible to some chefs, so we wanted to find a solution that lets everyone enjoy cooking.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/fede5f804ba566029bb57c0d1c66248eb1ea05dd.png"][/img][/p][p]As part of this change, we've introduced a [b]limit on the number of Helpers you can have on higher difficulties[/b]. I think this will lead to some interesting decision making for top tier chefs (instead of just buying every Helper they see.) We intend to iterate on this Apron system further, and potentially add more Aprons once we see what's working and what needs work. Your feedback is greatly appreciated![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/5e8a4c752d380de311c55fbd0a98b54b4369a2af.png"][/img][/p][p]We've finally given a fresh coat of paint to 2 of our screens. The first is the Omelet Selection screen, which looks way better and now shows [b]little trophies for each starter pantry that you've won [/b]with the currently selected Hat/Apron. [i](that I forgot to include in this screenshot, whoops. You'll see it once you start winning, chef!)[/i][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/731292f70039228408fbbf9fbd533aac2cbeb044.png"][/img][/p][p]The other screen is my personal favorite change of the update: [b]The Catalogue[/b]. Not only does it look incredible but we've gone through and [b]added[/b] [b]stats[/b] to each of the Ingredients/Helpers/Customers and different visuals if you haven't unlocked or encountered them yet. It's also [b]sorted by rarity[/b] so you can have a better idea of how likely you are to encounter everything.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/5544917d63f2657230ed6556bf2a12626861e9fa.png"][/img][/p][p]We've also added [b]5 new ingredients[/b] and [b]14 new achievements[/b] for you to play with, and in the coming weeks we'll be adding even more Ingredients and Helpers to keep the game consistently fresh.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/106a74b08ff04d2360974252372f4da9e5e335a4.png"][/img][/p][p]The last thing I want to mention is that the game is [b]currently on sale for 20% off[/b]! To reflect all the content we've added since launch, [b]we'll be increasing the price after the sale ends[/b], so go tell your friends that the hottest cooking roguelike of the summer is the cheapest it'll be for a long time![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for cooking with us, chefs! If you have any questions about these changes please pop over to our Discord and we're happy to answer them! [/p][p][/p][h2]v0.8.21 Patch Notes[/h2][h3]Content[/h3][list][*][p]Redesigned Apron System[/p][list][*][p]Real Time/Turn Based chef hat selection[/p][/*][*][p]Max Helper limit on higher apron difficulties[/p][/*][*][p]Ability to [b]FIRE[/b] unwanted Helpers for $1 (except Mythics)[/p][/*][*][p]Higher difficulties escalate in Target Score faster[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Catalogue Screen Art w/ stats and visuals for locked/unencountered entries[/p][/*][*][p]New Omelet Selection Screen Art[/p][list][*][p]Trophies appear for each Starter Pantry that you've beaten with the selected Hat/Apron[/p][/*][*][p]Unencountered Final Customers are hidden[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]5 New Ingredients (Red Onion, Watermelon, Avocado, Jackfruit, Mystery Meat)[/p][/*][*][p]14 New Achievements[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Skip button to Legendary Helper choice[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Take Random button to Legendary Helper choice[/p][/*][*][p]New art for Helpers: Chew Toy, Cornucopia, Dog Treat[/p][/*][/list][h3]Balancing[/h3][list][*][p]Oranges/Lemons/Limes are no longer buffed when discarded in shop while trashing[/p][list][*][p]This was an unintended feature I left in because it seemed clever and I wanted to see how players would exploit it. But it led to extremely broken and repetitive gameplay[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Minimalist can no longer appear in the first 3 rounds[/p][list][*][p]It was often impossible, my bad[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Trashy Embezzler: gives $1 per trash instead of $2[/p][list][*][p]This was way more powerful than I realized and could pay for itself almost instantly[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Bottom Feeder: gives $0.25 per [b]distinct tag[/b] instead of every tag on the side[/p][list][*][p]This was insanely broken. I don't know how I didn't realize but some chefs were generating $90+ on a single round with it[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Beam of Midas: now Legendary instead of Rare, so it can only be chosen as a free reward[/p][list][*][p]This better reflects how powerful it is in generating free money[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Use X specific ingredient request is more forgiving[/p][list][*][p]The number is chosen randomly between Max-1 and Max-3 different ingredients[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Green Onion is a Vegetable[/p][/*][*][p]Squid is Chewy, no longer Soft[/p][/*][*][p]Removed "Herb" tag, all herbs are now Vegetables instead[/p][list][*][p]There was only Parsley currently. I originally added the tag because I was worried there would be too many Vegetables. I don't want primary tags that only a handful of ingredients have.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Removed "Encased" tag, it didn't do anything[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Ingredients trashed by Travel Trash Dog are properly removed from Discard[/p][/*][*][p]Quarters will no longer cover the dollar sign[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where game could softlock if Wrench was trashed by Travel Trash Dog[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where game could softlock if Chocolate Coin was trashed by Fools Gold[/p][/*][*][p]Preventing Squids from wiggling while off the omelet during scoring[/p][/*][*][p]Extended Discard hover area for widescreen monitors[/p][/*][*][p]Gold no longer appears above UI[/p][/*][*][p]Gold properly fades when off the omelet[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where "Score X more than target" request would be checked at the start of a round[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed typos[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: v0.8.16 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]Hey chefs, very minor quality of life update that hopefully resolves the last game-crashing bug.[/p][p][/p][h2]v0.8.16 Patch Notes[/h2][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed critical bug where ingredients from discard would stop above the conveyor (I think)[/p][list][*][p]This one is tricky to reproduce so let me know if you ever see it occur again![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where Dispense icons could get stuck in middle of screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where mult arrows could stick around in shop screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where ingredients spawned by customers (Egg Shells, Chocolate Coins) could remain[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where ingredients on the right side of omelet could be added to the omelet that gets saved/served/eaten by Principal Clucker[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Quality of Life[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed Ascetic text to say "Ingredients [strike]worth[/strike] [b]earning [/b]$1+"[/p][/*][*][p]"Score X more than target score" customer request updates AFTER you surpass that score[/p][/*][*][p]Dispenses disabled by Minimalism no longer have an orange line behind them[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p]Locked crates without a Dispense get a Dispense between shops[/p][list][*][p]Previously players were punished for locking crates without a Dispense since it meant they would have 1 less Dispense available in the next shop[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Green Apron + Classic Starter Pantry has a new boss: Teacher version of Jane Clucker[/p][list][*][p]Previous Teacher (Lady Lana) had Egg Layer + Superstitious. Jane has Egg Layer + Child.[/p][/*][*][p]I made this change because this is the first boss chefs encounter while they're still learning the game. Superstitious requires the more complex strategy of adjusting ingredients with your dragged ingredient and can catch the player off guard.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Meaty Mini Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello chefs! Welcome to the Meaty Mini Update![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/fb98082abf1c5d556cbb7853d7eaab44f857b966.png"][/img][/p][p]We're hard at work on our first [b]MAJOR UPDATE[/b] for Omelet You Cook coming [b]early August[/b]! Until then we wanted to tide you over by finally giving some love to the 🥩Meat lovers out there. Enjoy these [b]4 new beloved ingredients[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/210789505db1dd10053bc46b745b64274dfdcbe6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/1aefe7fd85dcd9e1d7df530813f8774cc5ea9406.png"][/img][/p][p]We've also added an end to the conveyor belt! We think this looks better, makes for clearer gameplay, and removes a subtle advantage that chefs on widescreen monitors had.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/913bd76eb131ef249f3df9cdebd402fe9c0e2b9f.gif"][/img][/p][p]Thanks to your bug reporting, we've also fixed some critical issues including some that could ruin your run. As always, thanks for your help and feel free to join[url="https://discord.gg/pG9jkK3BTZ" style="button"] our Discord[/url] with any suggestions![/p][p][/p][p]We'll see you in a couple weeks for our [b]biggest update yet[/b]! Until then, happy cooking![/p][p]-Chef Schu[/p][p][/p][p]v0.8.09 Patch Notes:[/p][p]Gameplay[/p][list][*][p]Ingredient: [b]Chicken Nugget[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Ingredient: [b]Burger Patty[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Ingredient: [b]Hot Dog[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Ingredient: [b]Ribs[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Art[/p][list][*][p]Conveyor Belt now has an edge where ingredients fall off[/p][/*][*][p]Updated Steak art [/p][/*][/list][p]Balance[/p][list][*][p]Greedy trait: Forks spawn [b]half as frequently[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Patient trait: [strike][b]50%[/b][/strike] [b]30%[/b] slower conveyor[/p][/*][/list][p]Bug Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed bug where Mythic Helpers could appear in shop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where you could lock a Helper Crate, buy every remaining Helper, and crash the game when you try to open the Helper Crate. Helper Crates become unlocked on reroll if there aren't enough Helpers remaining[/p][/*][*][p]Right click no longer confirms choices[/p][/*][*][p]Trash Dog can't be clicked on before truck finishes arriving.\\[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where Reclaimed Wrench helper + Patient trait on Yellow Apron could lead to ending the round with Dispenses remaining[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The GOLDEN Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello chefs,[/p][p]Welcome to the GOLDEN Update![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/1002ba7e776a944984185c3095a0c4bf1c130b0e.png"][/img] [/p][p]After introducing the GOLD tag in the last update, we wanted to expand on it and build a starter pantry around it. So we've added [b]3 new ingredients[/b] that are gold (or like gold), [b]3 new customers[/b] with [b]2 new gold-related traits[/b], and of course [b]a new starter pantry[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/bd7f0c7e2013a794567429a3e1eb6a4ccb7f1834.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/1146aa924aadfbd553c77cfebf15bcfe8e2f1a5e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/591c8f9d324a8bab743bb7d7e9c1cc31b797d11f.png"][/img]  [/p][p]Meet the King of the Lily - the [b]Mythic Helper for the new starting pantry[/b]. He takes away all your base income in exchange for a chance to turn ingredients gold. But be warned, some of them may be [b]FOOLS GOLD[/b] instead. (pre-Hjalte programmer art but he do be kinda cute tho)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/5bb9e9fbfefac23a2c9427585be715f9d37d646d.png"][/img][/p][p]We've also [b]reworked the Catalogue[/b] to include more [b]stats[/b], the ability to [b]sort[/b] ingredients by tag, and a tab to see all the [b]Customers[/b] in the game. This improvement is an intermediate step - in the future we'll be polishing it further and adding proper art.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/7fd68fbe7e839202c25e7f2e047fb74af24385cb.png"][/img][/p][p]Lastly we made a balance change that we think highscore chasers will appreciate. We've heard your complaints that it sucks to get to the last round and be hit with the Manager who takes away dispenses or gives -0.5x mult to ingredients on the edge since that greatly limits your scoring potential.[/p][p]So now every pantry has a [b]predetermined Final Customer[/b]. This means that you'll get the same customer every time on the last round that you can prepare for and removes the RNG component so you can only blame yourself for failing to reach your highest potential![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/cc13e7d54c20231cbd41bc2b65ddbb1f69e021fb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for cooking with us, chefs![/p][p]-Chef Schu[/p][p][/p][p]v0.8.08 Patch Notes:[/p][p]Gameplay[/p][list][*][p]Ingredient: Truffle[/p][/*][*][p]Ingredient: Gold Leaf[/p][/*][*][p]Ingredient: Chocolate Coin[/p][/*][*][p]Customer Trait: Ascetic (-0.5x to ingredients with $1+)[/p][/*][*][p]Customer Trait: Charitable (Places Chocolate Coins on omelet on restock)[/p][/*][*][p]3 New Customers (1 Student, 1 Teacher, 1 Manager)[/p][/*][*][p]Starter Pantry: Golden[/p][list][*][p]New Mythic Helper (King of the Lily)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Recording more stats[/p][list][*][p]Helpers acquired + won with[/p][/*][*][p]Customers served[/p][/*][*][p]Number of ingredients served[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Customers are shown in the catalogue[/p][/*][*][p]Ingredients can be sorted in the catalogue by tag[/p][/*][*][p]Locked ingredients now show progress towards unlock[/p][/*][/list][p]Art[/p][list][*][p]Added Dispense VFX[/p][/*][/list][p]Balance[/p][list][*][p]Apples now score [b]1pt[/b] per every [strike][b]2[/b][/strike][b] 3 [/b]ingredients in pantry when chosen[/p][list][*][p]Honestly these will likely be reworked in the future. I really don't like how you can just score like 10+ points for throwing something on the omelet without thinking. In general I want the identity of Fruits to be carefully deciding when to snag one vs letting it get discarded because it may be more valuable later. Apple is so strong late game that you rarely make an interesting decision with it[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Bug Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed bug where sometimes you could hover an ingredient before scoring (and mult lines would stay on screen for awhile)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where the conveyor could steal ingredients from the omelet (especially when large + spinning)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Zesty Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello chefs![/p][p][/p][p]It's been a little over 2 weeks since we released into Early Access and today we dropped our [b]2nd content update[/b]! First of all I wanted to thank everyone who's left positive reviews so far - they help a ton to reach even more chefs! We're hard at work improving and expanding the game based on your feedback.

Welcome to the Zesty Update! We've got [b]3[/b] [b]zesty new ingredients[/b] that each [b]become stronger the more they're discarded[/b] throughout a round. I think these have potential to enable some very powerful setups, but I'll leave it to you to find out![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/bf389b1f4ce6cd02bdc9622af6557853f19aa23a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/b50a243912bcec1fe5ec99994552aaf0265d774d.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/160fef9bf48f5c50973fef33d9d48ba63e1015d3.png"][/img][/p][p]We've also added [b]2 more customers[/b] further utilizing the Grower/Shrinker traits from last week's update.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/6f0b373a8e7c9662940d9baa09489fd26d756015.png"][/img]
Lastly we've got some quality of life changes that our hardcore chefs will surely appreciate.
There's now a [b]Quick Restart button[/b] that appears when you haven't earned new unlocks. No longer are you forced to listen to Principal Clucker criticize you. Just know his disappointment is eternal.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/531faa084fe73fdce8958c40ccc4dd090a9ed073.png"][/img]
We've also added an [b]Animation Speed slider [/b]in the settings to help get you into the kitchen quicker.[/p][p]Hate that feeling when you want to move your spinach but it's covered by a massive Eggplant? Well now when hovering you can cycle through all ingredients under your cursor with [b]scroll wheel[/b], [b]arrow keys[/b], and [b]Q/E[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/fa7ae3fe58cc6f222b96f86fe466581cfa56fbee.gif"][/img][/p][p]The last thing I'll mention is that I reworked how input is handled. It should feel exactly the same but this may have unintended consequences, especially on alternate input methods such as Steam Deck. If you notice any issues please report them on Discord or via the in-game form!

Happy cooking, chefs!
-Schu
[/p][p]Full Patch Notes:[/p][list][*][p]Content[/p][list][*][p]3 New Ingredients (Lemon, Lime, Orange)[/p][/*][*][p]2 New Customers[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Quality of Life[/p][list][*][p]Quick Restart Button[/p][/*][*][p]Animation Speed slider[/p][/*][*][p]Hovered Ingredient Selection Cycling (scroll wheel, arrows, or Q/E)[/p][/*][*][p]Added SFX for shop buttons[/p][/*][*][p]Added SFX for forks[/p][/*][*][p]Game no longer pauses in background[/p][list][*][p]I might make this an option in settings upon request, just lemme know if you want it![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Bugs[/p][list][*][p]Fixed exploit where you could knock ingredients off trash conveyor belt[/p][/*][*][p]Preventing input during crate opening animation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where ingredients would still be on conveyor after leaving title screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fork colliders can no longer grab ingredients after being clicked[/p][/*][*][p]Squid can now wiggle in title screen[/p][/*][*][p]Meat Hater has new visual[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: A Beary Quick Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello chefs!

It's been 6 days since we launched [b]Omelet You Cook[/b] into early access, and thanks to you we've already reached:[/p][list][*][p][b]1,000[/b]+ chefs in the kitchen[/p][/*][*][p][b]10,000[/b]+ chefs wishing they were in the kitchen[/p][/*][*][p][b]47[/b] positive reviews![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/45cfbe534ad272abd2b3f2d807579c9ec60e444e.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]We've also pushed out [b]3 patches[/b] resolving the most critical and frequent pieces of feedback and today we're happy to finally give you a bit of new content!

Meet Augustus, Goldilocks, and Little Lino! [b]3 new customers[/b] with very different appetites![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/62aeaa60617015c8737b2563b2ee48d0795c3a58.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/f494f2ab70ac4a87c737f8bb5d4589f17f430587.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/8cafdfc02cd5c77aeb94e44a4dcaa19998e167da.png"][/img][/p][p]We also have [b]2 new ingredients[/b] entering the pantry:[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/42d5fe119af29f429aa888f540eeb7d03c040475.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/0cf12781431ee9f59fcb8547c846ada0ab9e132e.png"][/img][/p][p]Hmmmmm... how'd that [b]wrapper[/b] get on there?[/p][p][/p][p]A big thank you to everyone who's played, provided feedback, or left a review on the Steam page!
Please join us on [url="https://discord.gg/xMJaGjed8Z" style="button" buttoncolor="#378cfb"]Discord[/url] to discuss the update or suggest what we add in the next one!

Happy cooking![/p][p]- Chef Schu  [/p][p][/p][p]Full Patch Notes:[/p][list][*][p]Content[/p][list][*][p]Added 3 customers (2 students, 1 teacher)[/p][/*][*][p]Added Grower and Shrinker customer traits[/p][/*][*][p]Added eggplant[/p][/*][*][p]Added chocolate bar[/p][/*][*][p]Added Wrapped ingredient tag (-1x to self)[/p][/*][*][p]American Cheese is now Wrapped[/p][/*][*][p]Added tooltips to customer portraits + flavor text for each customer[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Balance[/p][list][*][p]Water Hose gives +2pts to Roots instead of +3[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Art[/p][list][*][p]Changed Dispense color to orange[/p][/*][*][p]Added Wiggly ingredient tag icon[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted backgrounds so certain Helpers don't blend in[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Sardine + Picky Eater colors so they don't blend in[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Bugs[/p][list][*][p]Fixed banana and pineapple colliders[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Dispenses beyond 12 not displaying properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where you could click through feedback form[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Patient trait icon[/p][/*][*][p]Can rotate w/ left/right arrows too now[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Shopkeeper's Update
notes.notes:
Sir Peck-a-Lot and his wonderous food truck has arrived! Load up on new relics and ingredients to create the perfect game-breaking omelet of your dreams.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/2e28cb9ae6008f97f505f7f55c9bfd78b687e5b8.png[/img]
There's a lot of changes in this update so give it a spin and lemme know what you like and what you think needs more work!

Changes:
[list]
[*] New Tutorial
[*] White Apron replaced with Green Apron -> only 7 rounds
[*] Shop Visuals
[*] Trash Mechanic (feed unwanted ingredients to a hungry dumpster dog)
[*] 18 New Relics
[*] 2 New Customer Traits (Wannabe DJ and Radical Centrist)
[*] Ingredient Tags Reworked (there's a lot more now)
[*] New SFX
[*] New Music Track (first pass from our new musician, more coming soon)
[*] When hovering ingredients/relics/crates, highlight your ingredients/relics that synergize
[*] Bug fixes and rebalancing
[/list]

With the introduction of the Trash mechanic, we're now feature complete! Any feedback you have on trashing or the new tutorial are especially appreciated over in our Discord server, or here on the Steam forums.

Thanks for your time, and happy cooking!
-Schu
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/e419703c2efe0a3cf7ab0516647c6c37826bd834.png[/img]

notes.title: Quarters & Stuff Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/0c201819aa70d0296cf83bdc7b28ff3f2d9d2597.png[/img]Do you like quarters? How about stuff? We've added both and more!

This update rebalances the economy yet again around the humble quarter. Get 4 of em and you get a dollar, just like real life!

We've also added a way to see which ingredients you've discarded, new tray decorations, and more!

Here's the highlights:
[list]
[*] Added Quarters - reworked several ingredients to award them to you
[*] Added Customer Requests as a way to earn additional money during each round.
[*] Rebalanced Economy around $5 per round
[*] Added discard icon you can hover to see discarded ingredients
[*] When out of ingredients, conveyor reverses so you see them restocking
[*] Trays are colored based on current apron + decorated randomly
[*] Many many bug fixes
[/list]
As always, any feedback is greatly appreciated over on the Discord! Happy cooking, chefs!

-Chef Schumy

notes.title: Tooltip Update
notes.notes:
Hey chefs,

This week's update aims to improve the player's ability to understand what the heck is going on. Not only are tooltips much better, but customers will announce their traits before each round so you know what to expect!

We've also added a leaderboard for each pairing of Starter Pantry and Apron! I'm looking forward to seeing who in our community has got that DAWG in em. Slide through our [url=https://discord.gg/pG9jkK3BTZ]Discord[/url] to brag about your rank or provide feedback on the leaderboards. I'm not 100% sure if a leaderboard makes sense for this game but we'll find out together!

The last major feature of this update is the most highly requested one: [b]ROTATION[/b]! You can now use scroll wheel while dragging an ingredient to rotate it. Lemme know what you think!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/1d0e0c374b1398bd5e88af86ca54637f05187342.gif[/img]

Hope you enjoy the update,
Chef Schumy

notes.title: Economy Update
notes.notes:
Sup chefs,

The first post-Next Fest update just dropped. This one is all about playing with ingredients that earn more money to use in the shop. I've also removed the customer requests because they draw too much focus, were often impossible, and just generally sucked. I might bring them back in some form eventually, but first I'd love some feedback on the Root ingredients!

There's also a bunch of smaller changes and improvements, so please check it out!

I'm very curious to hear how folks feel about earning additional money from Root ingredients, and if you have any feedback on the changes I'd love to hear them over in our Discord!

Happy cooking!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45193829/1f24d9fa9c362bd49a0a27b761d41d07616642fa.png[/img]
